GPROXY_DATABASE_URL.description: External libSQL/Turso database URL (libsql:// or https://). This deployment does not create D1.

GPROXY_LIBSQL_TOKEN.description: Database access token for the libSQL/Turso URL.

GPROXY_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Administrator password (at least 8 characters). Applied on startup. Sign in as admin at /console/.

GPROXY_MASTER_KEY.description: Saved 32-byte credential encryption key, encoded as 64 hex characters. Reuse it when updating.
